# Room read off the exchange

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`room-read-off-the-exchange` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](room-read-off-the-exchange.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Over one step of exchange, where a part's members take at most their capacity and give at most what they take, room holds; every optimum of every order rising with what couples in stands beyond at what the rest leaves less the part's capacity, lowering a condition just where the part has capacity.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The outcomes open to a part across one step are the levels after every balanced step in which the formations outside the part exchange as they do and each member takes from each condition at most its capacity, gives only to the listed conditions and gives them no more than it takes from them; the step that happened is one, and what such a step takes from a condition is what the rest takes with at most the capacity. (`Becoming.Flow.restTaken`, `Becoming.Flow.restGiven`, `Becoming.Flow.capacity`, `Becoming.Flow.ActsWithin`, `Becoming.Flow.Outcome`, `Becoming.Flow.Outcome.of_balances`, `Becoming.Flow.capacity_eq_zero`, `Becoming.Flow.ActsWithin.taken_eq`, `Becoming.Flow.ActsWithin.given_eq`, `Becoming.Flow.ActsWithin.part_taken_le`, `Becoming.Flow.other_of_out`, `Becoming.total_split`)
2. A member with capacity to spare at a condition can take one more unit there and give it to a condition of the family, and a member giving a unit at a condition can give it to the family instead; either step stays within the part's capacity and balances into the transfer of one unit from that condition into the family. (`Becoming.total_raise_at`, `Becoming.Flow.moveUnit`, `Becoming.Flow.redirect`, `Becoming.Flow.moveUnit_take`, `Becoming.Flow.moveUnit_give`, `Becoming.Flow.redirect_give`, `Becoming.Flow.moveUnit_taken_at`, `Becoming.Flow.moveUnit_taken_off`, `Becoming.Flow.moveUnit_given_at`, `Becoming.Flow.moveUnit_given_off`, `Becoming.Flow.redirect_given_at`, `Becoming.Flow.redirect_given_to`, `Becoming.Flow.redirect_given_off`, `Becoming.Flow.moveUnit_balances`, `Becoming.Flow.redirect_balances`, `Becoming.Flow.ActsWithin.moveUnit`, `Becoming.Flow.ActsWithin.redirect`)
3. Among the outcomes open to a part above any floors beyond, an outcome above another at a condition beyond is exceeded on the family by an outcome open to the part: under the other step some member takes more there or gives less there, and this step can move or redirect a unit into the family. Room holds with no premise beyond listings without repetition. (`Becoming.Optimum.Above`, `Becoming.Optimum.transfer_above`, `Becoming.Optimum.Above.transfer`, `Becoming.Optimum.member_below`, `Becoming.Optimum.Above.room`)
4. Above its floor, at every step to an optimum of every order rising with the family, each member takes its whole capacity at a condition beyond and gives nothing there, so the optimum stands at its floor or at what the rest leaves less the capacity; with no floor, every optimum stands at each condition beyond at the level before with what the rest gives, less what it takes, less the part's capacity, or at nothing. (`Becoming.Optimum.Above.full`, `Becoming.Optimum.Above.floor_or_full`, `Becoming.Optimum.above_nothing`, `Becoming.Optimum.optimum_beyond`)
5. Where no member may take from a condition beyond, every optimum leaves it where the rest leaves it; an optimum lowers it below that exactly where the part has some capacity there and the rest leaves something there; on a web, a dependence beyond met at the step is broken exactly where its need exceeds what the rest leaves less the capacity. (`Becoming.Optimum.optimum_untouched`, `Becoming.Optimum.optimum_lowers_iff`, `Becoming.sub_lt_self_iff`, `Becoming.Web.optimum_broken_iff_capacity`)
6. Witness on Diversion: a taker with capacity k at the source and none at the store draws k from the source into the store; for k at most two this is an optimum of the store's order among the outcomes open to it, and the dweller's dependence on the source at need two breaks exactly where k is positive. (`Becoming.Optimum.Drain.takerPart`, `Becoming.Optimum.Drain.takerCap`, `Becoming.Optimum.Drain.drawing`, `Becoming.Optimum.Drain.before`, `Becoming.Optimum.Drain.drawnTo`, `Becoming.Optimum.Drain.drawnLevel`, `Becoming.Optimum.Drain.formations_distinct`, `Becoming.Optimum.Drain.store_source_distinct`, `Becoming.Optimum.Drain.drawing_within`, `Becoming.Optimum.Drain.drawing_optimum`, `Becoming.Optimum.Drain.drawing_broken_iff`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. One step; the part (a Boolean on formations) and its members' capacities; the family and the beyond listed apart without repetition, the family holding a condition; the formations taking part listed without repetition, those outside the part exchanging as they do; a member may give what it takes to any listed condition; for breaks, each condition beyond met at its need at the step; decidable equality.
- That a given optimizer's order rises with just the couplings listed, and that its part's capacities are these, are supplied; the core asserts them of no actual optimizer.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- A course of steps: an optimizer choosing again at each step, the levels before moving with it, and a rest responding to the part (the pool laws) are not stated.
- Capacities enter as supplied amounts, as the levels before do; a member giving only to some listed conditions lies outside the outcomes stated.
- That the drain is a harm, or that a smaller capacity is better: no evaluation enters.
- Where the eligible outcomes are supplied otherwise, room can fail and the drive with it (Optimum.Drain.room_needed).
- **Counterexample:** drawing 0: a taker with no capacity at the source; the store's optimum leaves the source at two and the dweller's dependence unbroken (Optimum.Drain.drawing_broken_iff at k = 0): no drive where no units are shared. <details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell (NeurIPS 2020) assume, for their Theorem 1, a resource constraint strictly increasing in each attribute: room, supplied. Here it is read off conservation per member with capacity, the rest exchanging as it does. Saturation at an optimum is the saturated cut of a maximum flow (Ford and Fulkerson 1956) and the binding constraints of a corner solution. Reading (the AI's): at an optimum the drain at a condition beyond is the part's capacity there or all that stands, whichever is less; what the order registers of the beyond does not enter, what the part can take does.
